description: LW7 in one notification: terminal bytes are THIS notification, not an event — no seq from the durable log, no ring space, no subscription filter. The per-terminal `seq` is monotonic and allocates once per COALESCED chunk (16 ms or 32 KiB, LW10), not per byte or per read; `data` is base64 because a shell produces non-UTF-8 bytes (Q3). Delivery goes only to ATTACHED connections — the one(s) that called terminal.attach.
